name: print-social-carousel-purple-pink-tech-worker-illustration
title: Purple/pink tech carousel variant with worker illustration lead tile
whatItIs: A companion five-tile carousel from the same Minimal Tech brand, reordering the lead tile to foreground the illustrated worker beside a large gear icon, with the same diagonal stripe and circuit-pattern system.
whatItMeans: Reordering which tile leads a carousel while keeping the same visual system shows how one brand kit can generate multiple ready-to-post variants without new design work.
techniques: swap the lead/cover tile of a carousel to test different first impressions from the same asset set
pair a gear icon directly beside a character illustration to concretely signal 'engineering/build'
maintain identical color, type and pattern rules across variant tile orderings for brand consistency
bestFor: template packs needing multiple cover options

vocabulary.definition: the first slide of a multi-slide carousel post, designed to earn the initial tap/swipe
